en-US.description: Portable Windows desktop client (.NET 9 / WPF) with multi-account tabs for WhatsApp and Telegram, built-in message translation, and background preloading.
en-US.longDescription:
HidaChat is a modern, lightweight, and 100% portable Windows desktop client (.NET 9 / WPF) designed to run multiple WhatsApp Web and Telegram Web accounts simultaneously in organized horizontal tabs.

Key Features:
- Multi-Account & Multi-Platform: Run multiple WhatsApp and Telegram accounts concurrently with fully isolated session sandboxes and profiles.
- Instant Startup & Preloading: The active account loads with top priority while background tabs pre-warm transparently, eliminating switching lag.
- Built-In Message Translation: Hover over any incoming or outgoing message to translate it instantly, or translate entire chat threads with a single click.
- 100% Portable (Zero Installation): All session data, settings, and cache remain self-contained inside the local data folder—ideal for USB flash drives.
- Native Notifications & Overlay Popups: Rich interactive toast notifications and visual corner popups with platform badges (WhatsApp / Telegram).
- Dark & Light Themes: Automatic synchronization with Windows system theme and custom injected styling for both WhatsApp and Telegram.
en-US.name: HidaChat
